Hi all, Keaton here.

this happens:
I think the reason why this happens is because of Newold Doodad's Editor. I cannot get rid of it or anything because it's essentially the glue that holds everything together. And plus, there's no more than two Doodads that are present in the map.
Does anyone know what is happening here or a fix for this? I know a bit of RGSS3, but nothing that can be useful.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
does that happen when you start a new game or when you load a saved game or in both cases?
literally the error says that the script used a reference to an object that doesn't exist (NIL), and that can either be a compatibility problem or a missing definition.
and can you please link to the source of the script/editor you're using?

Actually... I was (somehow) able to figure out how to solve the problem.
To the right of the screen, you can see that there are some tiles that do not have any passibility whatsoever, nor can it be set. Which then when entering that area, prompts the game to throw an error.
The editor that I used was this, but I used a couple of bug-fixes that was available at the time:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...mpatible-with-rpg-maker-xp-vx-and-ace.101006/
